name: HP Adhesives Limited
summary: HP Adhesives Limited makes and distributes adhesives and sealants in India and abroad, including solvent cement, contact adhesives, PVA glue, epoxy products, spray paints, cyanoacrylates and sealants. It also supplies plumbing accessories, ball valves, tapes and drainage products such as manhole and gully covers, for plumbing, glazing and building facade uses.
